findings.summary: Concurrent polling of the outbox in claimDueResult will block because .for('update') lacks skipLocked: true.
findings.suggested_fix: Change `.for('update')` to `.for('update', { skipLocked: true })` to allow concurrent consumers to safely claim different due results.

findings.summary: Retrying commitTerminalOutcome with the same result will cause a primary key or unique constraint violation.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `.onConflictDoNothing()` or equivalent upsert logic to the `tx.insert(planResultOutbox)` statement to make the commit idempotent.
